about.description:
This feedstock packages the Gazebo Classic simulator, that will not be supported past 2025.
For new development, please consider migrating to Modern gz-sim simulator, available in conda-forge.
To simplify migration to gz-sim, we want to permit to side-by-side installation of gazebo and libgz-tools2, however they both install a command called `gz`.
So, this feedstock is building two different variants of the `gazebo` conda package:
  * One that contains `origname` in its build string that has higher priority and is installed if libgz-tools2 is not installed, that uses `gz` as the name for the cli helper of gazebo classic. This variant cannot be installed if `libgz-tools2` is installed. For forward compatibility, this variant also installs a `gz11` command.
  * One that contains `gzcompatname` that is co-installable with libgz-tools2, but that renames the `gz` commmand line tool to `gz11`.
Each of them is built against Qt 5 and against Qt 6, with `qt5` or `qt6` at the start of
the build string (for example `gazebo=*=qt6*`); the Qt 5 builds stay the default.
Packages built against gazebo keep the Qt variant they were built with (run_exports).
about.summary: Gazebo Classic robot simulator for research, design, and development.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: gazebo
  version: "11.15.1"
  major_version: ${{ (version | split('.'))[0] }}
  build_number: 24
  # The origname variant gets a higher build number so that it has higher priority,
  # and so do the Qt 5 builds over the Qt 6 ones (see conda_build_config.yaml)
  variant_build_number: ${{ build_number + (200 if GZ_CLI_NAME_VARIANT == "origname" else 0) + (100 if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt5" else 0) }}
  # Qt major version of this build and of the other one, for the linkage tests
  qt_major: ${{ GZ_QT_VARIANT[2:] }}
  qt_other_major: ${{ "5" if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6" else "6" }}
  # gazebo bundles the Qt 4/5-only Qt Solutions property browser; for Qt 6, build.sh
  # replaces it with the Qt 6 port that qttools ships (src/shared/qtpropertybrowser)
  qttools_version: "6.11.1"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/osrf/${{ name }}/archive/${{ name }}${{ major_version }}_${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 77a952971eabfd79e16d2582a355ee017a2e22cc369b68453323c0984b725126
    patches:
      - use-external-libs-config.patch
      - fix-invisible-meshes.patch
      - protobuf30.patch
      - ffmpeg8.patch
      - boost188.patch
      - boost190.patch
      - if: GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6"
        then:
          - qt6-cmake.patch
          - qt6-propertybrowser.patch
          - qt6-api.patch
          - qt6-compile.patch
          - qt6-model-right-menu.patch
  - if: GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6"
    then:
      url: https://download.qt.io/official_releases/qt/${{ (qttools_version | split('.'))[:2] | join('.') }}/${{ qttools_version }}/submodules/qttools-everywhere-src-${{ qttools_version }}.tar.xz
      sha256: 8e61835a679c93fa9c6065b142353c2071ba68e297898937c32a03777fcaf50d
      target_directory: qttools

build:
  number: ${{ variant_build_number }}
  string: ${{ GZ_QT_VARIANT }}${{ GZ_CLI_NAME_VARIANT }}h${{ hash }}_${{ variant_build_number }}
  script:
    env:
      GZ_CLI_NAME_VARIANT: ${{ GZ_CLI_NAME_VARIANT }}
      GZ_QT_VARIANT: ${{ GZ_QT_VARIANT }}

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cmake
    - pkgconf
    - ninja
    # We need all host deps also in build for cross-compiling gazebomsgs_out
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - libabseil
        - libprotobuf
        - libsdformat 9.*
        - libignition-cmake2
        - libignition-math6
        - libignition-transport8
        - libignition-common3
        - libignition-fuel-tools4
        - ogre 1.10.*
        - ${{ "qt6-main" if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6" else "qt-main" }}
        - freeimage
        - curl
        - tbb-devel
        # qwt 6.3 is built against Qt 6, qwt 6.2 against Qt 5
        - ${{ "qwt >=6.3.0" if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6" else "qwt <6.3.0" }}
        - tinyxml2
        - libtar
        - libccd-double
        - libboost-devel
  host:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - xorg-libxext
        - xorg-libxdmcp
        - xorg-libxau
        - libxcb
        - xorg-libxfixes
        - xorg-libxrender
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libice
        - xorg-libsm
        - libtar
    - if: linux
      then:
        - libglu
        - libgl-devel
        - libuuid
    - if: osx
      then:
        - bzip2
        - zlib
    - if: win
      then:
        - dlfcn-win32
        - tiny-process-library
    # deps
    - libabseil
    - libprotobuf
    - libsdformat 9.*
    - libignition-cmake2
    - libignition-math6
    - libignition-transport8
    - libignition-common3
    # Workaround for https://github.com/conda-forge/gazebo-feedstock/pull/143
    - libignition-fuel-tools4 >=4.6
    - libignition-msgs5
    - ogre 1.10.*
    - ${{ "qt6-main" if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6" else "qt-main" }}
    - freeimage
    - curl
    - tbb-devel
    # qwt 6.3 is built against Qt 6, qwt 6.2 against Qt 5
    - ${{ "qwt >=6.3.0" if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6" else "qwt <6.3.0" }}
    - tinyxml2
    - libccd-double
    - libboost-devel
    # additional deps
    - libcurl
    - tinyxml
    # - gts
    - ffmpeg
    - graphviz
    # gts (found via graphviz) includes glib.h, whose glibconfig.h is in glib, not libglib
    - if: GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6"
      then: glib
    # Avoid the libgdal metapackage, which pulls every optional plugin
    # (including TileDB and its unrelated cloud/AWS SDK stack). gazebo's
    # DEM/heightmap loader (gazebo/common/HeightmapData.cc) just calls the
    # generic GDALOpen() on GeoTIFF/USGS DEM files (see test/data/dem_*),
    # which libgdal-core already provides without any optional plugin.
    - libgdal-core
    - libusb
    # Bullet is not detected on win for some reason
    - if: not win
      then: bullet-cpp
    - dartsim-cpp
    - simbody
    - hdf5
    - openal-soft
    - libode
    - assimp
    - urdfdom
    - libblas
    - libcblas
  run:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - xorg-libxext
        - xorg-libxdmcp
        - xorg-libxau
        - libxcb
        - xorg-libxfixes
        - xorg-libxrender
        - xorg-libx11
        - xorg-libice
        - xorg-libsm
    - if: linux
      then: libglu
    # deps
    - libboost-devel
    - tbb-devel
    - libgdal-netcdf
    # Add constraint to avoid that old ogre gets installed during migratons,
    # see https://github.com/conda-forge/gazebo-feedstock/pull/188/files and
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/gazebo-feedstock/pull/203#issuecomment-1981995139
    - ogre >=1.10.12.1
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('gazebo', upper_bound='x') }}
    # gazebo's public headers expose Qt, so downstream packages must keep the Qt variant
    # they were built against
    - gazebo * ${{ GZ_QT_VARIANT }}*
  run_constraints:
    # Prevent to install side-by-side installation with libgz-tools2 or libgz-tools
    - if: GZ_CLI_NAME_VARIANT == "origname"
      then:
        - libgz-tools2 <0.0.0
        - libgz-tools <0.0.0

tests:
  - package_contents:
      # bin entries resolve to bin/<name> on unix and Library/bin/<name>.exe on win
      bin:
        - gzserver
        - gzclient
        - gazebo
        - gz11
        - if: GZ_CLI_NAME_VARIANT == "origname"
          then: gz
      files:
        - if: osx
          then: lib/libCameraPlugin.dylib
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then:
          - gzserver --version | grep "Gazebo multi-robot simulator, version"
          - gzclient --version | grep "Gazebo multi-robot simulator, version"
          - gazebo --version | grep "Gazebo multi-robot simulator, version"
      # gz11 prints its help on stderr, so we only check that it exits successfully
      - gz11 help
      # the GUI links the Qt major version of its variant, and only that one
      - if: osx
        then:
          - otool -L $PREFIX/lib/libgazebo_gui.dylib | grep -q libQt${{ qt_major }}Core
          - "! otool -L $PREFIX/lib/libgazebo_gui.dylib | grep -q libQt${{ qt_other_major }}"
      - if: linux
        then:
          - patchelf --print-needed $PREFIX/lib/libgazebo_gui.so | grep -q libQt${{ qt_major }}Core
          - "! patchelf --print-needed $PREFIX/lib/libgazebo_gui.so | grep -q libQt${{ qt_other_major }}"
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: linux
          then: patchelf

about:
  homepage: http://classic.gazebosim.org/
  # gazebo is Apache-2.0; its GUI includes a Qt property browser: the Qt 5 builds the one
  # bundled with gazebo (Qt Solutions, BSD-3-Clause), the Qt 6 builds the one from qttools
  # (LGPL-3.0-only)
  license: ${{ "Apache-2.0 AND LGPL-3.0-only" if GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6" else "Apache-2.0 AND BSD-3-Clause" }}
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - if: GZ_QT_VARIANT == "qt6"
      then: qttools/LICENSES/LGPL-3.0-only.txt
  summary: Gazebo Classic robot simulator for research, design, and development.
  description: |
    This feedstock packages the Gazebo Classic simulator, that will not be supported past 2025.
    For new development, please consider migrating to Modern gz-sim simulator, available in conda-forge.
    To simplify migration to gz-sim, we want to permit to side-by-side installation of gazebo and libgz-tools2, however they both install a command called `gz`.
    So, this feedstock is building two different variants of the `gazebo` conda package:
      * One that contains `origname` in its build string that has higher priority and is installed if libgz-tools2 is not installed, that uses `gz` as the name for the cli helper of gazebo classic. This variant cannot be installed if `libgz-tools2` is installed. For forward compatibility, this variant also installs a `gz11` command.
      * One that contains `gzcompatname` that is co-installable with libgz-tools2, but that renames the `gz` commmand line tool to `gz11`.
    Each of them is built against Qt 5 and against Qt 6, with `qt5` or `qt6` at the start of
    the build string (for example `gazebo=*=qt6*`); the Qt 5 builds stay the default.
    Packages built against gazebo keep the Qt variant they were built with (run_exports).

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - seanyen
    - wolfv
    - Tobias-Fischer
    - traversaro
